verdict.rationale: Auth0's AI docs explicitly state that agents can use CIBA to request approval for sensitive operations via push, SMS, or email, even when the user is not actively using the app. They also list human-in-the-loop controls with CIBA as a core agent-security feature. SCA with Dynamic Linking further ties transaction details to the approval, which helps prevent tampering. missing for 10: in-depth implementation docs (setup steps, polling/notification modes, SDK specifics), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CIBA agent flow.
